TITLE: Ever Platform
UNAVAILABLE: The Ever Platform connection is not switched on for this installation. Its operator can switch it on with EVER_CONNECT_ENABLED=true; until then nothing is sent to Ever Platform.
ERROR: Ever Platform settings could not be loaded. Please try again.

CONNECTION.EVER_CLOUD: Operated by Ever Cloud. The connection of this installation is managed by Ever.
CONNECTION.KEY_MATERIAL: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY (or a strong, unique JWT_SECRET) on the API before connecting: the connection key and the documents of the connection are stored encrypted with it.
CONNECTION.NOTICE: Connecting sends Ever Platform: the product (Ever Gauzy) and its version, how it is installed (EVER_INSTALL_SOURCE), whether this API also serves Ever Teams, the public part of a key this installation makes for the connection, the address of this web app so app.ever.co can send you back here (https only; Ever Platform keeps only a fingerprint of it) and, if you choose, the ids of this organization and its tenant to link it at once. No address of this installation's API, no name and no e-mail address is sent. Paste the connect code you created in app.ever.co.
CONNECTION.SECRET_SHORT: The secret that protects the keys of this connection (ENCRYPTION_KEY, or JWT_SECRET) is shorter than 32 characters. Use a long, random one.
CONNECTION.KEY_UNREADABLE: The connection key of this installation cannot be read since ENCRYPTION_KEY or JWT_SECRET changed, so nothing can be sent. Disconnect, then connect again with a new connect code.
CONNECTION.RETURN_UNUSABLE: The address of this web app (CLIENT_BASE_URL) is plain http outside this computer, so it is not sent: after a consent in app.ever.co, come back to this page yourself.
CONNECTION.REVOKED: Ever Platform revoked this installation's connection. Create a new connect code in app.ever.co to connect again.

APPROVALS.TITLE: Approvals requested
APPROVALS.ACCEPT_CONFIRM: Accepting starts moving, for the whole installation:
APPROVALS.DECLINE_CONFIRM: Declining withdraws the consent. Nothing is sent.

POLICY.TITLE: Instance policy
POLICY.DESCRIPTION: A denied integration is off for every organization of this installation, and no administrator can enable it.

DISCONNECT.TITLE: Disconnect
DISCONNECT.EFFECTS: Disconnecting stops every integration, removes the organization links and the entitlement documents, and stops the heartbeat and the event feed. Ever Platform is told when it can be reached. The anonymous usage statistics are not affected.

LINK.DESCRIPTION: Link this organization to an Ever organization: paste a link code created in app.ever.co. Ever Platform then knows the ids of this organization and its tenant, and the name of the product.
LINK.NOT_CONNECTED: This installation is not connected to Ever Platform yet.

INTEGRATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Nothing moves for an integration until an owner or administrator of the linked Ever organization enables it in app.ever.co. You can disable any integration here at any time; it stops at once, even when Ever Platform cannot be reached.
INTEGRATIONS.OPERATOR_ONLY: This integration acts for the whole installation: only its operator manages it.

LOOKUP.TITLE: Check this contact on Ever Platform
LOOKUP.WHAT_IS_SENT: Only salted hashes of what you enter leave this installation: the values themselves never do, and Ever Platform keeps none of them. Only organizations that chose to be discoverable can be found. Nothing is written back to the contact.
LOOKUP.VAT_SUGGESTED: Suggested from the contact's fiscal information. Check it before you send it.

CANNOT_BE_CHECKED.empty: Cannot be checked: nothing to check.
CANNOT_BE_CHECKED.no_country: Cannot be checked: add the country (two letters) or the country prefix of the number.
CANNOT_BE_CHECKED.no_at_sign: Cannot be checked: this is not an e-mail address.
CANNOT_BE_CHECKED.bad_domain: Cannot be checked: the domain of this e-mail address is not valid.

ERRORS.rate_limited: Too many checks. Try again in {{ seconds }} seconds.
ERRORS.integration_disabled: Checking contacts on Ever Platform is not enabled for this organization.
ERRORS.entitlement_required: Checking contacts is not included for this organization on Ever Platform.
ERRORS.generic: The check failed. Please try again later.

LOOKUP.AUTO_CHECK: Check a contact automatically when it is opened
LOOKUP.AUTO_CHECK_HINT: Off by default. When on, the e-mail of a contact is checked each time the contact is opened (the answer is kept for up to a day). It is part of what was enabled in app.ever.co.
LOOKUP.AUTO_CHECK_FAILED: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
